# Claims Assessment Memo

## Summary

Ferrous Gate Engineering Ltd (policy CC-1703) reported on 26 September 2026 the theft of a laptop and an external drive from a locked storage unit at a university library. The loss falls within clause 4.2 (Contents). Exclusions 7.1, 7.3 and 7.5 do not remove cover on the documents in the file. Two points cannot be confirmed from the file (see Coverage analysis). The claim is accepted as covered, with a reserve of 4,732 dollars.

## Facts

- The insured is Ferrous Gate Engineering Ltd, under policy CC-1703. [notice of loss]
- The loss was reported on 26 September 2026. [notice of loss]
- The reported loss is theft of a laptop and an external drive from a locked storage unit at a university library. [notice of loss]
- The theft was reported to the police on 28 September 2026 under reference CR/2026/4247, by Ferrous Gate Engineering Ltd. [police report]
- The police report records the items as a laptop and an external drive, stolen from a locked storage unit at a university library. It states the items were in a locked container at the time. [police report]
- The laptop was supplied by Beacon Office Supply, amount 2,603 dollars. [invoice 1]
- The external drive was supplied by Crane & Sons Electronics, amount 2,129 dollars. [invoice 2]
- The file does not state the date of the theft, and it does not contain the policy schedule. [notice of loss] [police report] [policy]

## Coverage analysis

**Insuring clause.** Clause 4.2 covers loss of business contents caused by theft, at the premises named in the schedule and at any other premises while in the insured's custody. The loss is theft of business equipment (a laptop and an external drive) from a locked storage unit at a university library. The items were held in a storage unit used by the insured, which is consistent with custody at premises other than those scheduled. [notice of loss] [police report] [policy cl. 4.2]

**Other cover clauses.** Clause 4.5 (Transit) is not engaged, as the loss is not described as occurring while the equipment was carried between premises. Clause 4.7 (Escape of water) and clause 4.9 (Electrical surge) are not engaged, as no water or surge event is reported. [notice of loss] [police report] [policy cl. 4.5, 4.7, 4.9]

**Exclusions.**

- **Clause 7.1 (Unattended property).** This excludes theft of portable equipment left unattended in a shared or public space, unless it was in a locked container or locked room. A university library may be a shared or public space, but the police report states the items were in a locked container at the time, and the notice of loss describes a locked storage unit. The exception in clause 7.1 applies, so the exclusion does not operate. [police report] [notice of loss] [policy cl. 7.1]
- **Clause 7.3 (Wear and tear).** This excludes gradual deterioration. The loss is theft, not deterioration, so the exclusion does not apply. [notice of loss] [policy cl. 7.3]
- **Clause 7.5 (Unproven loss).** This excludes a theft loss not reported to the police within seven days. The police report is dated 28 September 2026, and the loss was notified to us on 26 September 2026, so the theft occurred on or before 26 September. The police report falls within seven days if the theft occurred on or after 21 September 2026. The file does not give the date of the theft, so this should be confirmed against the insured's account. [police report] [notice of loss] [policy cl. 7.5]

**Points to confirm.**

1. The date of the theft, to close out clause 7.5.
2. The policy schedule, to confirm the premises and whether an excess is shown (see Reserve). [policy cl. 4.2, 9.1]

## Decision

Covered, under clause 4.2 (Contents). Exclusions 7.1, 7.3 and 7.5 have been considered. Clause 7.1 does not apply because of its locked-container exception, clause 7.3 does not apply to a theft loss, and clause 7.5 is not engaged on the dates in the file, subject to confirmation of the theft date.

## Reserve

| Item | Source | Amount (dollars) |
|---|---|---|
| Laptop | [invoice 1] | 2,603 |
| External drive | [invoice 2] | 2,129 |
| **Sum of invoices** | | **4,732** |
| Excess | [policy cl. 9.1] | none shown |

Under clause 9.1 the reserve is the sum of the invoices, less the 250 dollar excess only where the policy schedule applies one. The schedule is not in the file and no excess is shown, so none is applied. **Reserve: 4,732 dollars.** If the schedule, once obtained, shows an excess, the reserve reduces to 4,482 dollars. [invoice 1] [invoice 2] [policy cl. 9.1]
